entities.name: Ramos
entities.description: A mysterious dragon engine on Mercadia, venerated as a creator god by many of its peoples; originally from Phyrexia.

entities.name: Mercadia
entities.description: The plane where Ramos is revered by many religions.

entities.name: Cho-Arrim
entities.description: A people of Mercadia whose religion holds Ramos especially important.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: Brother who first had Ramos in his service during the Brothers' War.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Captured and reprogrammed Ramos to protect the people of Terisiare; later confirmed Ramos's story.

entities.name: Brothers' War
entities.description: The conflict between Mishra and Urza in which Ramos served.

entities.name: Sylex Blast
entities.description: The event during which Ramos rescued humans and merfolk from Argoth.

entities.name: Argoth
entities.description: Place from which Ramos gathered humans and merfolk.

entities.name: Weatherlight
entities.description: Ship that crash-landed on Mercadia after fleeing Rath.

entities.name: Bones of Ramos
entities.description: Five powerstones Ramos possessed, protected by dryads, part of the Legacy.

entities.name: Henge of Ramos
entities.description: Place where Ramos was met by Weatherlight's crew.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: Owner of the ship Recreant, which Ramos destroyed.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: Invasion during which Ramos defended Mercadia City.

entities.name: Mercadia City
entities.description: City on Mercadia defended by Ramos.

events.summary: Ramos, originally in Mishra's service, is captured and reprogrammed by Urza to protect the people of Terisiare.
events.quote: Later, he was captured and reprogrammed by Urza to protect the people of Terisiare in case they were wiped out in the conflict.

events.summary: During the Sylex Blast Ramos gathers humans and merfolk from Argoth and planeshifts them to Phyrexia, then escapes through a portal to Mercadia.
events.quote: Ramos gathered up several humans and merfolk from around Argoth

events.summary: On his descent Ramos accidentally crashes into a Mercadian city, killing many people.
events.quote: he accidentally crashed into a Mercadian city, killing many people

events.summary: The rescued people build cities and come to venerate Ramos as their creator.
events.quote: came to venerate Ramos as their creator

events.summary: Ramos explains his true origins to the Weatherlight crew and gives them the powerstones containing his essence.
events.quote: he explained his true origins to the crew and granted them the powerstones containing his essence

events.summary: Ramos intercepts and destroys Volrath's ship Recreant during Weatherlight's flight from Mercadia City.
Ramos fights in defense of Mercadia City during the New Phyrexian Invasion.
events.quote: Ramos fought in defense of Mercadia City.

relations.note: served Mishra during the Brothers' War, per Ramos himself
relations.quote: he had originally been in the service of Mishra
he was captured and reprogrammed by Urza
